summary: Frontend-only smoke tests for Flint static proxy site. Verified static asset serving (HTTP + headers), service-worker registration on /window.html, and local JSON data-loading on games/apps/newtab/vm pages. Primary reported bug ('ServiceWorker script evaluation failed / does not allow Service Workers') is FIXED.

integration_issues.flow: Live proxy browsing via address bar
integration_issues.issue: External wisp WebSocket servers (wss://web-launch-kit-6.preview.emergentagent.com/wisp/, wss://glseries.net/wisp/) return 404 / are unreachable from the container network. Per review request this is out of scope (third-party) and NOT a task failure, but end users on the preview URL cannot actually load proxied sites unless a reachable wisp server is configured in server list.
counter.leelive2021.workers.dev fetch blocked by CORS (No Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Non-blocking, cosmetic console error.

ui_elements.welcomeModal: Visible ('Welcome to Flint' + 'Join the Discord' + 'Continue to browser') in screenshot

action_items: OPTIONAL: In UI, add a data-testid or clearer id for the forward button (current selector heuristic did not find it, but back/reload/home/address-bar all detected). Not blocking.
OPTIONAL: Note in README that live proxy browsing requires a reachable wisp server; the bundled server list may need updating for end users.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/server.js correctly sets Service-Worker-Allowed: / for /sw.js and application/wasm for .wasm — good.
All previously-dead CDN references (scramjet CDN, GitHub raw JSON URLs) have been swapped to local paths as described in files_of_reference; verified via network + rendered image counts.
Static site has no data-testid attributes (third-party site hosted as-is) — acceptable per task context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static site served by frontend/server.js from frontend/public. No /api routes exist. SW is registered at scope '/'. Live proxying through address bar depends on external wisp servers which are unreachable from this container — do not treat that as a task failure. All local data files (data/*.json) and scramjet assets are served correctly.
